title: Activate selected Math Discovery CLR RED and falsify coherent metadata against actual published bindings
commitMessage: test: probe selected CLR RED reflection against published binaries

contribution.summary: Activate Math Discovery selected CLR RED and observe that coherently forged binding metadata can pass declarative validation but fail against actual immutable published CLR methods.
contribution.value: Use the pinned NUGET_LOCAL Composition, IR and Quantities private archives without restoring or rewriting them. Verify their archive/embedded DLL hashes, load the three compiled assemblies into an isolated managed context and match the four selected public static method signatures by reflection. Create three coherent, re-fingerprinted test-only forged descriptions (missing member, wrong parameter, wrong result) accepted by the existing RS287 metadata-only CLI but refused by real CLR method resolution; preserve a runtime-only authorization rejection. Activate only T2 and T2-RED under the existing M8 phase; declare no completion.
debtChanges: RS292 succeeded first-pass, durably completed protocol T1 and admitted T2/T2-RED ready; neither selected CLR RED nor its future GREEN/Verification has been executed.

Prior RS279/282 source-free private-package consumers checked positive selected calls, while RS287 guarantees only internally consistent declarations; this RED run independently falsifies metadata that names no real compiled method.

Only disposable build/artifacts copies and source-owned tests are touched; private archives, historical source-only flags, broker authority, package identities, M8 backlog and sibling repositories remain unmodified.
